Later it receives its tributary the Khabur and divides into the Hillah and Hindiyah branches before flowing past Najaf and entering Lake al-Hammar near the Persian Gulf. FTP, name this river, which then forms the Shatt-al Arab with its companion, the Tigris, before emptying into the sea.
